<translate>
'''Frieza's Ship''' (Frieza's Spaceship) stands on the Ajissa Plains of [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]]. It's the home of the master [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza|Frieza]], who only trains Evil-aligned players.
</translate>

<translate>
== Who lives here ==
</translate>
<translate>
'''[[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza|Frieza]]''' teaches a wide range of skills (including Fly, [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Sense|Ki Sense]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Potential Unlock|Potential Unlock]]) and his own ki attacks such as the Death Beam and the Supernova. He needs Evil alignment (40 or lower).
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding it ==
</translate>
<translate>
The ship generates once per world, in the Ajissa Plains. The [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Namekian|Capsule Corp Namekian]] sells a '''Frieza's Spaceship Map''' for 1 Tier-1 Radar Chip. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate frieza_ship}} on Namek. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Finding structures|Finding structures]].
</translate>

<translate>
Like every master's home, the ship can't be damaged by ki attacks (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Protection|Protection]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story ==
</translate>
<translate>
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Saga|Frieza Saga]] quest 19, ''Raid Frieza's Ship'': find Frieza's Ship and defeat 10 of Frieza's Soldiers.
</translate>
